res: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons
cimm: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained
langs: the languages it knew in life

traits.d: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.d: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

The wraith targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a specter in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The specter is under the wraith's control. The wraith can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.

tips: Иммунитет к урону: necrotic, poison — не тратьте на это ресурсы, ищите другой тип урона.

Сопротивление урону: acid, cold, fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons — вполовину менее эффективно, предпочтите другой тип.
Иммунитет к состояниям: charmed, exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained — заклинания/эффекты с такими состояниями не подействуют.
Слабый спасбросок: Силу (-2) — эффекты и заклинания на эту характеристику с высокой вероятностью пройдут.
Имеет скорость полёта — учитывайте дальнобойные атаки и заклинания, у существа может не быть наземных ограничений.
